## Record vs saga

- **[Record]:** Simon Grunau (16th c.) alone: "Iwan and Georg" poisoned by a knight to avenge the betrayal. En.wikipedia (Ostrów Agreement, after Jonynas 1984): a false rumour, no reliable source. Sofija is the only child in the record; Vytautas's letters never accuse the Order. A "Jurgis and Jonas" on the 1390-92 hostage list were kinsmen who came back alive.
- **[Saga invention]:** The boys' temperaments, Šešiapirštis's errand, the ragana's offer (Book II ch. 6-10). They are not on the Order's written hostage list in the book ("the household's escort").
